# Console output

Write to the run's console output, which the finished run reports.

**Library:** [Standard library](index.md#standard-library), for apps and code-pipeline hooks. More in [Cogniscript](../../../concepts/cogniscript.md).

| Call | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`Print`](#print) | Writes text to the run's console, without a line break. |
| [`PrintLine`](#printline) | Writes text to the run's console, followed by a line break. |

### Print

Writes text to the run's console, without a line break.

```c
void Print(string text)
```

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `text` | `string` | The text to write. |

Each call adds one entry, marked as ordinary output, to the run's console output (`consoleOutputs` on the run). Use [`PrintLine`](#printline) to end the text with a line break, and [`Trace`](tracing.md#trace) for diagnostic output. Join other values in with `+`: `Print("Total: " + total)`.

### PrintLine

Writes text to the run's console, followed by a line break.

```c
void PrintLine(string text)
```

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `text` | `string` | The text to write. |

Each call adds one entry, marked as ordinary output, to the run's console output (`consoleOutputs` on the run); the entry's text ends with the line break. Use [`TraceLine`](tracing.md#traceline) for diagnostic output.
